title.en: Short: Can a robot do your shopping?

en.title: Can a robot do your shopping?
lines: Could an AI do your weekly shop, and pay for it?
You tell it what you need, like detergent and soap.
It checks the shops, adds up each total, and picks the best one.
Then it pays, but only inside the limit you set.
In this made-up example, Shop B wins on the total.
What else could an AI agent pay for? Comment below.
